Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner confirmed that Appleton, Wisconsin is in Outagamie County and incorrectly stated that the county seat of Brown County is Green Bay. This information was not re-verified after Step 15, leading to final confirmation as Green Bay instead of De Pere. The Planner relied on an earlier assumption without cross-checking details on Brown County's Wikipedia page. This created a consistency problem when the error was later identified at the last step, but actions were mistakenly traced to step 12, where the error was made in the unchecked assumptions and assumptions persisted without re-verifying.
